name: Happening Events Milwaukee
description: Happening is a community-built database of real-world events in the Milwaukee area. Connect it to Claude to search upcoming events. Found something happening that isn't listed? Ask Claude to post it, and it becomes discoverable for everyone. You can also browse the tag catalog and review your own submissions. Whether you're planning your weekend or helping neighbors find what's going on, Happening puts Milwaukee's event scene at your fingertips.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Happening Events Milwaukee to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Happening Events Milwaukee to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.happening-events.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Happening Events Milwaukee MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Happening Events Milwaukee provides these MCP tools: get_event, list_my_submissions, list_tags, post_event, and search_events.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Happening Events Milwaukee?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Happening Events Milwaukee in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.

_published_faq.name: Does Happening Events Milwaukee MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Happening Events Milwaukee requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Happening Events Milwaukee is developed by Happening Events. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
